name: claudiverse-seat
description: Makes every Claude Code session (2.1.287+) a claudiverse seat: registration, remote input and interrupt, the message mirror, remote answers. Works offline as plain Claude Code.

server_url.title: claudiverse server
server_url.description: Address of the claudiverse server, for example http://claudiverse.example:4010. Leave empty to keep this machine's sessions out of claudiverse.

seat_token.title: Seat token
seat_token.description: The token this machine's seats use with the claudiverse server.
